prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred agency size. That said, here are well-regarded agencies with a strong San Francisco presence grouped by what they’re best known for:

Large/full-service & creative
- R/GA — brand strategy, creative, product design and integrated campaigns.
- AKQA — creative + technology; strong in digital product design and brand experiences.
- Huge — customer experience, design, and digital transformation.

Performance, paid media & growth
- 3Q Digital — performance marketing (PPC, programmatic, social) and analytics.
- Jellyfish — paid search, SEO, analytics and programmatic with enterprise experience.
- Wpromote — growth marketing focused on paid media, social, and search.

Data/CRM/technical
- Merkle — data-driven customer experience, CRM, analytics, and programmatic.

How to pick the best one for you
- Define clear goals (brand awareness, leads, revenue, CAC, etc.) and KPIs.
- Set a budget or at least a monthly/annual range.
- Prefer boutique vs. enterprise? Some firms are large consultancies; others are scrappy growth shops.
- Ask for case studies with measurable outcomes in your industry.
- Check references and contract terms (reporting cadence, cancellation, IP ownership).
- Start with a short pilot project before committing long term.

If you tell me what you need (services required, monthly budget, target industry, company size, timeline), I’ll shortlist 3–5 San Francisco agencies that are a strong fit and suggest specific questions to ask them.
